{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
ds = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
ds['revenue'] = ds['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = ds[ds['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Drop the QA orders
ds_clean = ds[ds['revenue'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Drop refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
ds_clean = ds_clean[ds_clean['status'] == 'completed'].copy()

# Filter to only converted customers
converted_customers = ds_clean[ds_clean['converted'] == 1]

# Now calculate the mean age of converted customers, excluding those with age = -1
converted_customers_valid_age = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age
mean_age_converted = converted_customers_valid_age['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_age_converted"}
